requirements: Validate both x_data and y_data for NaN, positive infinity, and negative infinity.

Preserve length validation, CSV validation, successful plotting behavior, and the public API.
Keep the existing focused regression tests intact; do not weaken or remove them.
Do not change sonar-project.properties, quality-gate rules, analysis scope, or add suppressions.

At least one fix node repairs the implementation without changing the tests.
The subsequent complete pytest suite passes.

approval.content: Restore create_plot's direct finite-value validation so it checks both x_data and y_data, reports every affected axis once in axis order, and preserves all existing behavior. Keep the tests and SonarQube configuration unchanged.

code.content: The regression is in create_plot's _validate_finite_values input: it currently supplies only the x_data named values. Restore the y_data named values in the same validation call so the shared helper checks both axes and retains its existing deduplication and message behavior.
